answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 165785 Country: India Title: Dua which I can recite so that nobody can ever insult me or put blame on me. Question: Dua which I can recite so that nobody can ever insult me or put blame on me. Answer ID: 165785 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 136/109/M=03/1440) Read the below verse extensively: وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَاء وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَاء بِيَدِكَ الْخَيْرُ إِنَّكَ عَلَىَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ Similarly, read the below dua 3-3 times and mu’awazatain (Surah Falaq and Surah Naas) in the morning and evening: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العظيم بسم الله الذي لا يضر مع اسمه شئ فى الأرض ولا فى السماء وهو السميع العليم . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
